scheme_name: Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture Sub Scheme Horticulture Mission for North East and Himalayan Region- Meghalaya
other_conditions: Applicant must be a permanent resident of Meghalaya
Applicant must be a bonafide farmer engaged in agriculture
Applicant must own or lease land of at least 0.2 hectares
benefits_summary: Provides grants, subsidies, training, and assistance for planting material production, area expansion, plantation rejuvenation, water sources, protected horticulture, beekeeping, mechanization, post‑harvest activities and market infrastructure.
documents_required: Copies of mandatory documents (self‑attest, if required)
